privileged_info_for_vlm: The target website is https://books.toscrape.com/. The specific product page to audit is https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/a-light-in-the-attic_1000/index.html. The export must be a CSV named 'attic_inlinks.csv' located in '/home/ga/Documents/SEO/exports/'. The export must contain at least the columns 'From', 'To', and 'Anchor Text'. Screaming Frog's 'Inlinks' tab (bottom pane) is the standard way to view this data for a selected URL.
